description:
BOIS NOBLE COUTURE – Noctra Embera
Premium Handmade Wooden Bead Bucket Bag
Brief and Technical Product Description
Noctra Embera , from Atelier Emine's Bois Noble Couture collection, is a premium handmade bucket bag model characterized by its vertical volume structure and permeable woven surface, where natural wood beads are combined with gold-toned connecting elements.
The model's exterior is constructed from oval-shaped, polished wooden beads arranged in a regular grid (lattice) pattern, reinforced with gold-plated micro-link details. This combination gives the product both a natural and a high-end contrasting aesthetic.
The cylindrical body shape is designed to maximize internal volume; a balanced volumetric relationship is established between the semi-permeable structure of the outer frame and the inner pouch.
